items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: you replaced him with Garland... That was Foster Lewis... who was the one that took Foster Lewis's place? A guy named Jake White.

ctx.x: He got married and had to go back home. His bride wanted to go back, and that's when you got Tutti Garland.
Oh, Foster Lewis, yeah. Yeah. No, but he never did go. He never had come to New Orleans.
No, the one that came to New Orleans that got married, and his bride wanted to go back to Laplace, and you replaced him with Garland. Which one was it? Must have been a bass player.
